label: Formulated and introduced The Floating Man Thought Experiment
description: Ibn Sina (Avicenna) formulated and introduced the concept of "The Floating Man Thought Experiment", which became a seminal contribution in mind philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in mind.
historicalContext: Introduced during the Medieval & Islamic Golden Age as part of Ibn Sina (Avicenna)'s canonical writings.

label: Tahafut al-Falasifa refuted Avicennian eternal emanation and natural necessity
description: Al-Ghazali launched a devastating orthodox theological critique against Avicenna's Neoplatonic Aristotelianism in The Incoherence of the Philosophers, refuting eternal cosmos claims and formulating an occasionalist critique of causal necessity.
dialecticalTension: Rationalist natural causal necessity and eternal cosmos versus Divine omnipotence, miracles, and voluntary creation.
historicalContext: Baghdad, 1095 CE. Al-Ghazali held the chair of Islamic jurisprudence at the Nizamiyya Academy before undergoing spiritual crisis and refuting falsafa.

citations.author: Al-Ghazali
citations.work: The Incoherence of the Philosophers (Tahafut al-Falasifa)
citations.quote: The connection between what is habitually believed to be a cause and what is believed to be an effect is not necessary in our view.
